code:
Profile menu -> Debug Security Rules (on)
Reload the page

Security log shows, per ACL evaluated:
  incident.read         -> PASS (role: itil)
  incident.caller_id    -> FAIL (role missing)

No guessing. The real trace, named.
caption: Stop reconstructing the evaluation from symptoms — read it.

code:
Profile icon -> Elevate Roles -> security_admin

Why not always-on?
  security_admin can bypass ACL script checks
  -> editing one ACL could silently break the
     ACL that governs ACL editing itself

Elevation scopes the bypass to one session.
caption: Even admins don't get a permanent bypass of their own rules.
